items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 78:1
items.html: Because MAD is the level that descends from above downward for the purpose of clothing; and since there is here only the level of Nefesh, it is therefore in the filling of Heys, for nothing is revealed here but the level of Nefesh. (Page 931, Item 115; Page 943, Sub Header, “and what”).
